messages:
anya: Quick check from today's pricing heatmap — calc area has lots of dwell but low clicks. heatmap: https://redwood-internal/hm/510123. Key: impressions 3.9k, calc CTA CTR 1.6%, hover-to-click ~10:1, median hover 3.5s. Thinking a micro-nudge to capture intent and tie into the webinar.

lexi: Sounds right. Proposal: show a tiny contextual pill after 2 hovers (>2s) that offers 2 choices: 'Quick cost snapshot' or 'Join pricing clinic'. Both open a 1-2 field flow (email + company size). Keep it lightweight.

jess: I'll add GTM events: rw_scout_hover, rw_scout_pill_shown, rw_scout_choice, rw_scout_submit. Capture calc_session_id, page_variant, and prefill email when logged in.

sales-ops: Routing plan: if choice==clinic AND (company_size >= 150 OR utm contains "enterprise"), route to SDR queue 'pricing-scout-fast' with 24h SLA; tag lead with variant and calc_session_id. If snapshot chosen, send automated snapshot email + add to nurture. Escalate to AE if ARR estimate > $40k.

analytics-bot: Deployed a client badge under utm=pricing-scout that surfaces the pill. Monitoring events and will report conversions in 72h.

anya: Action items: lexi 1 micro-copy for pill + 2 CTAs + one-line FAQ anchor by EOD. jess 1 GTM events + dashboard for funnel by tomorrow AM. sales-ops 1 HubSpot workflow + 24h SLA + templates by tomorrow noon. analytics-bot 1 confirm payload includes calc_session_id and logged_in_email. We'll run a 7-day A/B test and reconvene with heatmap + funnel metrics. :rocket:
